verdict.rationale: PagerDuty is a SaaS incident-management platform, so open-source availability is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows only peripheral public GitHub repositories: an MCP server, a bot-published OpenAPI schema repo and developer docs. None of these is the product's core source, and no open license is documented for any of them, so this is adjacent material and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
